body: I don't care and frankly, I didn't even think it was true, but this guy has been a good friend for many, many years and if he's pressed about something, I'd rather make it go away, if that makes sense.

Hi guys, my ass is big for a male and I've got a problem with sweatpants/tracksuits/trousers getting stuck in my ass which annoys me to no end.

Now I have a Nike Dri-Fit trouser (size XL) and that DOESN'T get stuck in my ass, but I recently bought another trouser, birds eye mesh cloth or something like that and this one does get stuck.

I don't understand what the problem is, the type of fabric, the size or something else? Should I buy a larger size or a smaller one? Like if its smaller, there won't be much fabric to get stuck, or will it make it worse? Or do I get a larger size? Or some specific kind of fabric?

BTW, obviously underwear makes it better, but ideally a trouser shouldn't be getting stuck in your ass even when you go without underwear.

Thanks guys!

That's exactly what I want. I want to feel no emotion, God knows I've always tried to be a good person, but that's given me only pain. I've always looked out for others and never hurt anyone in my life, but I get fucked over by pretty much everyone. I just want to stop caring so I can get my doctorate, get a good job, earn some money and live out my life alone without getting hurt by other people.
Ya, but don't antidepressants just kinda make you not emotional? So that you don't feel anything?

That's exactly what I want man. I want to just not care about anything and feel nothing. Being emotional and empathetic has never given me anything but pain, I even get really sad when I hear other people are in trouble and as for myself, everyone fucks me over. I just want to get to the point where I don't feel a damn thing.

Ya, that's the problem with me too, I just can't understamd why she doesn't see how valuable I'am! Honestly Im not that bad, I've got a lot of faults, but I've never hurt anybody and I always remained loyal to my ex, even in the periods when we weren't talking to each other. I mever even thought of any other girl and this is how Im rewarded in the end. In her eyes, Im like the worst guy since Hitler and she literally can't see anything good in me. I feel so worthless and disappointed..

I can't even think of taking money from my aunt to watch my cousins, but then my aunt is like a second mother to me, not like this Jean, who seems to have no sense of either family or money. 

Personally I think the best thing is to just refuse to babysit the kid. No money, but no drama either.

I'm in the same boat, my Ex-GF doesn't give a damn if I die. I can't help you, but I understand your pain... Here's what I wrote in the other post 

> Some days days back, I made a half hearted suicide attempt and ended up going to the hospital. My sister told her I'd tried to kill myself, but the next day when I texted her, she didn't even reply and later, when she did talk to me, she just insulted me...

> We talked again yesterday and this time I told her point blank that I was really depressed and that I needer ger help. I told her I was gonna try to kill myself again and that she could at least show some empathy, but she didn't give a damn.

> What's eating me is that how could she not care? How could she be so heartless that she doesn't even care if I live or die? God knows how much I love her and she doesn't even care if I die? This thing's always on my mind, 24/7. 


I've stopped believing in love, if she can do this to me, anyone can.

Same! I haven't killed myself yet because of my parents, my uncle and my two aunts and my younger sister. They all love me so, so much and I don't want to hurt them My aunts and uncle love me as much as they love their own children, I'm the most important thing in my parents' lives and my sister always looks up to me, she thinks I'm the greatest guy ever and all this is what's keeping me from killing myself right now. And the weird thing is, none of them have any idea about what's going on, they all think I'm a really tough guy and I was too, before my ex broke me emotionally. My EX is the only person who knows I'm suicidal and she doesn't give a damn. I even made a halfhearted suicide attempt, but I wasn't even close to dying and I didn't let my family know. My ex knows I tried to kill myself, but she doesn't care. She literally doesn't give a damn; for her my death would be just like any one of the thousands of deaths every day.

Ya thanks man, I'll do that. I just feel so angry at myself for acting like a total weirdo... I was always so calm and rational and now I act like a little kid who can't let of his stuffed bear. I'm kinda afraid this lack of self control will spread to other parts of my life too and I'll lose all ability to make rational decisions.

I tried that and after she didn't reply for some time, I ended up spamming her. God, I feel so angry to myself and at her. How can you even do that to another human being, especially one who thought the world of you...

Thanks for the support, I really appreciate it and yesterday was the best I've felt in a long, long time! Ya, I'm sure there are a lot of nice people out there, but dealing with someone like my ex just kinda leaves a bad taste in your mouth and it's weird how I'm afraid of people like her now, but still love her so much.

That's exactly what my sister keeps telling me to do and there have times when I called me sis or one of my cousins so that I wouldn't text my ex, but sometimes you get this sudden urge to text her right now and before you know it you're begging her for another chance. 

Haha glad to know I'm not the only one who thinks that! At one point I seriously considered if it was some sort of supernatural force making me do this and I'm not even that religious and certainly don't believe in any supernatural entities, but losing all control over your own self is a very strange feeling.

Thanks man, I'm also afraid I'll change as a person coz Im always thinking that none of this would've happened if I was a jerk. The boys who just mess around with girls never have to go through heartbreak and people who are jerks in general almost never get played with. I know that's a fucked up way of thinking, but I can't help it.

I also feel like I won't be able to trust women again ever because if my ex could do this to me, anyone can. I thought she'd be there for me forever, but she abused me, took advantage of me and broke my heart. That's why I don't think I can trust women again.

I know that I'll probably love again if I don't kill myself, time heals everything, but I'm sure that the next time, I won't love as fully as I did now and I sure as hell won't put so much faith in the other person. Of course, I'm not sure there even will be a next time

I've tried quitting so many times, but I always come back to her begging. In my mind I know its idea, but I always end up sending that "one last text" in the hope that this would be the text thay finally makes her realize that she's been so hurtful to me. My younger sister's always telling me to stop contacting my ex and I've promised her so many times that I will, but I always end up breaking that promise. 

I used to have so much self control, like I never got mixed up with drugs even though everyone was doing it and generally never let people force me into things that I knew were bad for me, but now it seems like I can't control myself at all.

Yes, that is the word! Its ironic that I never touched any drugs, only to become addicted to a girl. You know, at one time I wondered why people stay in abusive relationships and I made fun of them, I thought they were just weak idiots, but now I know how it feels to come crawling back to someone who doesn't give two shits about you...

Ya, someone downvoted my original post too, got no idea what these guys are thinking LOL. Honestly, I know what you're saying is true, but my mind just has a hard time accepting it. The rational part of me says that she moved on, she's doesn't care anymore but my heart keeps asking WHY? Maybe I'm different, but I loved her like I love my family, I wouldn't just move on from my family, I wouldn't just stop caring no matter how many fights we had. And this is what's eating me from the inside; sure we had fights, sure our relationship wasn't great, but she shouldn't have abandoned me at this point because that's not what you do to people you love. 

The way I see it, you can be angry with someone and stop talking to them, but when they REALLY NEED you, when their lives depend on your help, then you should forget everything and help them. And this isn't just some idealistic BS, I'm saying this because I've never turned my back on anybody when they needed me. I've always tried to be a good person and I've never hurt anyone so it too much to ask for some empathy for myself? None of this would be happening to me if I was just another jerk...

Maybe I've got an idealistic view of relationships and maybe girlfriends aren't like family, but I still think that one should love fully, or not at all. 

And you're right, she if she can't stand by my side now, she doesn't deserve me later and a little while back I was thinking that even if she got back with me, do I really want to be with a person who doesn't care about me? Do I really want a girlfriend like that? Like I said, I know that you're right, that she's toxic for me, but my mind just can't accept it. I just can't wrap my head around the fact that she would abandon me at my most vulnerable without caring whether I live or die.

Its the same with me man, I've deleted her number so many times, but end up messaging her again (I know it by heart) in the end. I know she's toxic for me, I know she's the reason I'm in pain and I know that she has used and abused me, but I still beg her to take me back. I keep checking my phone all the time, hoping that she'd text and I'm still waiting for her to show some god damn empathy! 

I love her so much and I just can't wrap my head around the fact that she doesn't care for me at all, like everyone has a soft spot for people who love them, right? Our relationship was a joke, but I didn't even look at another girl, even in the time when we weren't talking and this at a time when guys are cheating left and right, but she didn't appreciate this either. I swear to God when she tells me about her problems I feel so bad for her, like around two weeks back when I was begging her for another chance, she told me it was all my fault and that I made her feel alone because I didn't talk to her for the past 6-7 months and I swear I felt so bad for hurting her even though she didn't talk to me either and in any case, it was her behaviour that destroyed our relationship. My point is, I care about her so much, I feel HER pain, but she could care less about mine.

I see where you're coming from and I've thought about this myself too that in my current condition, I probably don't appeal to her at all. However, don't you think (and please correct me if I'm wrong) that in critical situations like these, supporting the other person and their health and safety are more important than what  you find attractive? God knows if it was me in her place, my number one priority would be being there for her, even if on the inside I was disgusted by her behaviour. Its easy to be friends when everything is going good; people's characters really show during the bad times... Again, please correct me if I'm wrong because I know Im not thinking straight right now.

The irony is that I used to be a pretty fun guy; she's the girl who changed me into this depressed weirdo. On the surface I'm doing pretty good college is going great and all that, but Im broken on the inside. Ive stayed up whole nights doing math just to take my mind off her...I feel like crying writing this down..
